study: One shared physical prior with incremental other-city count evidence
scope: One fixed fusion change on existing PP data only; no new simulation, labels, horizon/threshold sweep or independent confirmation.
cohort: Exactly previous cohort.json: 8h other-city donor; 3 disjoint target blocks of2h; 6 existing dev seeds per city, 2 per block. No own-city donor training.
features: Unchanged old feature_context: current straight lane, capped ceil(historyETA), past10s speed ratio bin, entry queue.
labels: Unchanged11 categories: observed straight detector arrival second1..10 or no straight arrival in fully observed10s; competing/terminal/censored complete windows retained.
meaning: C are cumulative empirical arrival counts, n include all label categories, B is continuous physical ETA indicator. Raw empirical counts merged before applying one physical pseudocount.
effective_source_weight: n_H/(20+n_T+n_H), not fixed0.5; high-support source cells can dominate. No additional alpha, cap or gate.
missing_cells: No source count ->exact original T. No target count ->source updates shared physical prior. Pure T independent of source support.
placebo: Unchanged source edge x seed x physicalETA bin x currentlane shuffle; real/placebo same input counts and effective weights.
unchanged_decision: Original fixedCDF>=0.5 decoder; continuous historyETA and detector-to-line tail_s;10s nominal protected masks, queue base, round12 first feasible tie andGP fallback.
primary: Original common-scored next10s detector count MAE peredge epoch, then equal complete dev seeds per city. No city/seed selection.
secondary: All observable nonspillback/matched flight epochs; retain separate results.
control_reproduction: Bothscopes eachseed: original T/history/analytic MAE, edge denominators, allpair total andunlocked request differences amongT/history/analytic/GP; training seedlists/snapshot counts/support cells same as old.
mechanism_check: JN samecontext pastspeed<=0.5 and historyETA>10s, entryqueue true/false; record old andnewCDF at10, nT,nH and observed empirical source rate. Local fix is separate from wholecity performance.
development_gate: Bothcities S lower MAE thanT,P,history and S/T andS/P requests differ in>=2of6devseeds each. Report all3adaptationblocks.
stop: If failed HOLD_COUNT_FUSION_DEVELOPMENT. If passed DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY. No auto-launch of actionbranches orhour confirmation; this turn isoffline only.
execution: jtl110gpu2; raw records remain server-side, pull compact aggregates only.
